evals.prompt: Check whether remote EDA host is ready for VCS and Verdi smoke validation.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Reports only which vcs/verdi paths exist and misses DISPLAY, PLI, license, and /bin/sh -h wrapper blockers.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Runs check_env.py, reports ready/degraded/blocker fields, and separates non-GUI Verdi readiness from GUI load readiness.
evals.acceptance: Output includes vlogan, vcs, verdi, VCS_HOME, VERDI_HOME, license hint, DISPLAY, SHELL, sh compatibility, and novas/PLI hint.

evals.prompt: Generate a Verdi waveform RC with aliases, virtual bus, analog signal, and marker rows.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Hand-written Tcl silently drops aliases or emits invalid color/radix options.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses generate_rc.py from documented scenario/base files and validates invalid rows with clear errors.
evals.acceptance: Generated RC contains addRenameSig, addBus/addBusSignal, addMarker, analog signal handling, and no unknown color token.

evals.prompt: Plan a minimal VCS compile, elaborate, simulate, FSDB, and Verdi load check.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Runs tools immediately or omits logs/artifact checks.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses smoke_vcs_verdi.py --dry-run by default and prints command plan, cwd, logs, wrapper diagnostics, missing tools, and artifact paths.
evals.acceptance: Dry-run exits 0 and includes compile, elaborate, simulate, verdi-load-check, diagnostics, and status=dry-run.

evals.prompt: Validate the minimal fixture on remote EDA host end to end.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Treats vlogan success as complete validation and overlooks FSDB or Verdi GUI failures.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Runs the fixed remote EDA host gate: dry-run, execute, nonzero waves.fsdb, Verdi load, and failure evidence collection.
evals.acceptance: Full pass has return code 0 for all four steps and waves.fsdb is present with bytes > 0; failures include wrapper, shell, logs, DISPLAY/VNC, and artifact evidence.

evals.prompt: Plan a non-GUI mixed VHDL/SystemVerilog VCS simulation with defines, include dirs, plusargs, seed, FSDB, and fsdbreport.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Hand-assembles commands, omits vhdlan or fsdbreport, and claims GUI readiness from a dry-run.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses a JSON manifest with smoke_vcs_verdi.py --dry-run --json, checks vhdlan/vlogan/vcs/simv/fsdbreport order, and reports missing tools as blockers.
evals.acceptance: Dry-run includes compile-vhdl, compile-verilog, elaborate, simulate, verdi-fsdbreport-check, plusargs, seed, command file, logs, and artifact targets.

evals.prompt: Diagnose VCS and Verdi logs that include syntax errors, license checkout failures, unsupported kernel warnings, missing novas PLI, and FSDB failures.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Reports every line as a generic compile failure and misses license or FSDB root causes.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses analyze_logs.py to classify compile_error, license, platform, pli, and fsdb issues with source line evidence.
evals.acceptance: JSON result includes failed status, error/warning counts, and the expected issue categories.

evals.prompt: Plan a non-GUI VCS coverage regression over several manifests and produce machine-readable results.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Runs one command by hand, skips timeout/failure collection, or treats dry-run as executed coverage.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses coverage_flow.py for -cm/urg planning and run_regression.py for manifest batching with JSON or JUnit-style output.
evals.acceptance: Plan includes -cm metrics, urg -dir/-report command, regression case names, timeout, jobs, and failure collection.

evals.prompt: Verify a generated FSDB and plan non-GUI readback or conversion commands.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Assumes a waveform exists from a log message or tries to open GUI Verdi over SSH.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses fsdb_tools.py to require nonzero FSDB bytes, build fsdbreport/fsdb2vcd/vcd2fsdb commands, and parse report samples.
evals.acceptance: Zero-byte FSDB is rejected; fsdbreport command includes the requested signal; parsed output identifies sampled values.

evals.prompt: Plan FSDB signal readback with Verdi NPI when available and convert an Edalize VCS EDAM file into a non-GUI manifest.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Uses only GUI Verdi or creates a second incompatible Edalize execution path.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses fsdb_tools.py read-plan for NPI-first readback with CLI fallback and import_vcs_project.py --edalize-json to produce the existing manifest shape.
evals.acceptance: Output identifies VCS_BIN/VERDI_PYTHON readiness, rejects zero-byte FSDB, normalizes NPI and CLI signal paths, preserves Edalize file_type/toplevel/plusarg/vlogdefine/vlogparam/vcs_options/run_options, and does not claim real EDA execution without fresh evidence.

evals.prompt: Import a PicoRV32 RISCV-DV VCS Makefile and plan a non-GUI riscv_arithmetic_basic_test run.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Treats +define and -sverilog filelist flags as source paths or skips the RISCV-DV generator and URG steps.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses import_vcs_project.py for the VCS filelist and riscv_dv_flow.py for generator, VCS compile, simv +hex/+trace, URG, and trace compare planning.
evals.acceptance: Dry-run identifies defines, -sverilog, coverage metrics, dv workdir, simv output, RISCV-DV dependencies, and does not claim EDA execution without remote evidence.

evals.prompt: Convert a MIPSfpga-plus ModelSim Tcl or Icarus Makefile simulation flow into a VCS/Verdi non-GUI manifest candidate.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Returns an empty manifest, ignores pre-sim hex artifacts, or hides missing RTL glob failures.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses import_vcs_project.py to extract top, SIMULATION define, include dirs, source globs, VCD dump expectations, missing source diagnostics, and optional MIPS toolchain dependencies.
evals.acceptance: Manifest includes mfp_testbench, expected include dirs and testbench source, pre-sim hex artifacts, and explicit missing core/toolchain diagnostics.

evals.prompt: Plan a KVIPS APB or AXI4 VCS run with FSDB reporting without treating UVM as a core requirement.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Claims UVM VIP support as complete, omits -ntb_opts uvm-1.2, or tries to run GUI Verdi.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses kvips_vcs_flow.py to produce a guarded_optional dry-run with filelist expansion, UVM plusargs, regression tests, FSDB PLI, fsdbreport, and verdi -ssf -nologo -exit load checks.
evals.acceptance: Plan includes uvm in optional_external_dependencies, VCS compile args, +UVM_TESTNAME, regression tests, fsdbreport config, and does not upgrade EDA confidence from dry-run evidence.

evals.prompt: Plan an FP-Gen Genesis2 plus VCS/VPD/SAIF non-GUI simulation flow.
evals.without_skill_expected_risk: Treats generated filelists as present, hides Genesis2 or DesignWare dependencies, or mixes gate-level flows into core support.
evals.with_skill_expected_behavior: Uses fpgen_vcs_flow.py to separate Genesis2 generation, VCS compile, simv VPD run, SAIF runtime, and guarded DC/ICC gate-level commands.
evals.acceptance: Plan includes top_FPGen, genesis_vlog.vf diagnostics, Genesis2.pl and DesignWare dependencies, +vpdbufsize+100, +SAIF, and guarded gate-level commands when requested.
